tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "ls -la | head -80; rg --files | rg '("'^|/)logx/'"' | head -100; find .. -name AGENTS.md -o -name PROJECT_BRIEF.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' core/logx/config.go && sed -n '1,240p' core/logx/fields.go && sed -n '1,280p' core/logx/logger.go && sed -n '1,220p' core/logx/readme-cn.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,300p' core/logx/logs.go && sed -n '1,280p' core/logx/richlogger.go && sed -n '1,220p' core/logx/vars.go && rg -n \"ServiceName\" core/logx"

/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w core/logx/logs.go core/logx/richlogger.go core/logx/writer.go && git diff --check && git diff -- core/logx/logs.go core/logx/richlogger.go core/logx/writer.go core/logx/readme-cn.md core/logx/readme.md'
